name: Gabriel DaCruz
what_it_does: Personal site of Gabriel DaCruz, composer for concert, film and television, trained in Lisbon and London: his films (The Bay, War Flowers, The Gauntlet), his film cues and concert works, his suite and album, and all 18 of his videos playable in the page. Six designs, English and Portuguese, a catalogue of every work, llms.txt for AI agents; every fact sourced.
